summary: All 8 UI-facing acceptance criteria for the blue holographic AION reference-design home (login gate, greeting/orb/composer/quick-actions, local canned chat reply, quick-action composer fill, tools/import controls, theme picker switch+persist across emerald/amber/mono/reference, logout, and console/network cleanliness) verified via named browser checks. This is a frontend-only app (no backend/AI integration per spec_deviations); no API-bearing criteria exist, so no backend test files were required.

checks.name: aion-login-gate-redirects-home
checks.evidence: login-card visible at /giris; admin/AION#2026 submit redirects to '/' with assistant-home-screen and greeting-heading visible

checks.name: aion-blue-holographic-home-renders
checks.evidence: ai-orb-avatar, greeting-lead='Merhaba, Mehmet', greeting-heading, greeting-subtitle, chat-composer-form, composer-pro-banner, 3 quick-action cards all visible; document.documentElement data-aion-theme='reference'

checks.criterion: Sending a prompt opens the conversation panel with a reply
checks.name: aion-send-prompt-opens-conversation-panel
checks.evidence: Typed tscheck-prompt into chat-message-input, clicked chat-send-button -> conversation-panel visible, user text shown in conversation-message-list, list grows to >=3 children after ~650ms (canned assistant reply appended)

checks.name: aion-quick-actions-fill-composer
checks.evidence: quick-action-surprise-button/create-button/summarise-button each populate chat-message-input with non-empty Turkish text; interaction-status visible after click

checks.criterion: Import file and Tools controls respond
checks.name: aion-import-file-and-tools-controls
checks.evidence: chat-tools-button toggles chat-tools-popover open/closed; chat-import-file-button triggers a native filechooser event; assistant-home-screen remains mounted (no crash)

checks.name: aion-theme-picker-switches-and-persists
checks.evidence: sidebar-settings-button opens theme-picker; theme-option-emerald/amber/mono each set data-aion-theme accordingly; after page.reload() theme remained 'mono' (localStorage persistence); theme-option-reference restores 'reference'

checks.name: aion-logout-returns-to-login
checks.evidence: sidebar-logout-button click -> URL matches /giris and login-card visible

checks.criterion: No console errors on the core journey
checks.name: aion-no-console-errors-core-journey
checks.evidence: Console 'error' listener and response listener (status>=400) both empty across login -> home render -> send message + reply -> close panel -> open theme picker
